meaning:
αὐτάρκεια, -ας, ἡ
(αὐτάρκης, which see),
(a) sufficiency (MM, see word): in subjective sense (see Milligan, NTD, 57), 2Co.9:8;
(b) contentment: 1Ti.6:6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
But godliness with contentment is great gain.
